target_claim_boundary: Not FRANK runtime evidence. Tests whether candidate observables can distinguish recurrent regimes in controlled traces.
result: A two-axis delta+residual rule fixes the stalled-vs-converged confusion but still mislabels numerically stable overthinking as successful convergence. A third task-utility/marginal-value axis is therefore required to distinguish HALT_SUCCESS from HALT_OVERTHINKING in this controlled example.
research_delta: LoopDynamicsReadout should not be reduced to spectral/Jacobian stability plus residual pressure. It also needs outcome/marginal-utility evidence. Numerical stability != cognitive usefulness.
next_live_test: Ubuntu H1 frozen episodes with real state deltas, unresolved pressures, verified outcome utility and fixed-vs-adaptive recurrence controls.
